paintedHatchCorners.rule: fix8.py's face rule: rows from the frame line to the last row whose middle (x 615-650) is brighter than 140; left edge at the middle of its ramp (median over the rows); right edge the column before the dark outline (median)

method: sheet corners: camera report C's capsule.units[0].hatch projected with the view's camera (pv6-C-marks.json); painted: the largest connected warm paper-white region (R>170, G>150, B>120, R>=B) within 40 px of the sheet's hatch, its corners the extreme points along the diagonals (view B's hatch record's method)
